notes: FASTCDC algorithm (deterministic, two-level gear-hash; local-profile because spec parameters/domain are incomplete)
CDC algorithm ID registry (LITERAL=0x00, RABIN=0x01 optional unsupported, FASTCDC=0x02, BUZHASH=0x03 optional unsupported, CUSTOM=0xF0-0xFF unsupported)
CdcChunk, CdcMetadata, CdcMapRecord, CdcMapHeader, CdcMap public data structures
CDC_MAP TLV v1 binary parse/write (16-byte header + 48-byte records; self-describing via Hash_Algorithm_ID; parseable without boundary regeneration)
Recipe Mode structural validation (32-byte hash array only; no portable boundary-regeneration verification claim)
CdcError enum with Malformed/Unsupported/ReservedValue/LimitExceeded variants

functions.name: ArchiveReader::read_all_logical_files
functions.description: High-level bounded extraction: reads all entries, assembles fragment groups via reconstruct_fragments, applies sparse zero-fill via apply_sparse_reconstruction, and returns LogicalFile values. Resets the read cursor so it can be called even after prior next_entry calls. When allow_lossy is false (default), a missing fragment returns FragmentGap. When allow_lossy is true and LOSS_TOLERANT is set, degraded output is returned with LogicalFile::is_degraded = true. AEAD and format errors are never suppressed. Sparse Map on a non-zero fragment index returns InvalidMap immediately (never suppressed by allow_lossy). Sparse reconstruction uses LFH Uncompressed Size as the final logical file size; trailing holes are filled with 0x00. CRC32 is verified over fully reconstructed bytes (including holes) when PER_FILE_CRC is set; CrcMismatch is returned on failure. Empty Areas (Name Length == 0, IS_FRAGMENT == 0) are excluded from the returned list. EXPANSION-BOMB PROTECTION: a tiny stored payload combined with a huge Uncompressed Size and a sparse extent near the end (e.g. Uncompressed Size=1025, max_decoded_entry_size=1024, sparse map {offset=1024, length=1}, one stored byte) is rejected with SAR_ERR_LIMIT_EXCEEDED before any large allocation is attempted — not SAR_ERR_INVALID_MAP, because the sparse map is structurally valid. The same protection applies to fragmented sparse entries using fragment-0's Uncompressed Size.

ffi.notes: High-value FFI candidate; Vec<LogicalFile> ownership needs care.

parameters.description: Base object bytes supplied explicitly by the caller.

PatchError::BaseMissing when base is required but not supplied (checked by caller before this call)

resource_limits.model: unified ResourceLimits struct threaded through all parsing and reconstruction paths
resource_limits.primary_protection: Configured ResourceLimits are the primary and deterministic protection against allocation-based DoS. There is no separate runtime memory budget by design.
resource_limits.defense_in_depth_note: Runtime memory tracking is not implemented. Configured limits are both the primary and only protection layer; they are not defense-in-depth.
resource_limits.allocation_gate: ResourceLimits::allocation_len is the single gate for all u64-to-usize conversions. No conversion bypasses it.
resource_limits.limit_exceeded_error: SAR_ERR_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (SarError::LimitExceeded) is returned before any dangerous allocation.

sparse_expansion_bomb.attack_shape: tiny stored payload + huge Uncompressed Size + sparse extent near end of logical file
sparse_expansion_bomb.protection: apply_sparse_reconstruction and read_all_logical_files reject oversized logical_size before allocation. Error is LimitExceeded, not InvalidMap.
sparse_expansion_bomb.fragmented_sparse: Fragmented sparse entries use fragment-0's Uncompressed Size; the same LimitExceeded check applies.
sparse_expansion_bomb.test: pipeline_memory_tests::sparse_expansion_bomb_reject and sparse_expansion_bomb_bounded_success verify reject and bounded-success paths

compression_expansion.protection: sar-compression enforces a caller-provided max_output_size parameter. Decompression output is bounded by max_decoded_entry_size.

fec_recovery_working_set.fec_internal_ceiling: sar-fec caps XOR and Reed-Solomon parity allocations at 256 MiB internal ceiling.

cli_resource_safety.extract: Validates sparse apparent size against max_decoded_entry_size; creates temp file; scatter-gather seeks; renames only on success. Does not allocate large zero buffers for sparse holes.
cli_resource_safety.repair: Pre-checks archive size before fs::read; enforces max_repair_working_set; does not finalize output after limit failure.
cli_resource_safety.error_reporting: CLI resource-limit failures reported as: resource-limit error (SAR_ERR_LIMIT_EXCEEDED)

loss_tolerant.note: allow_lossy never bypasses ResourceLimits. Fragment gaps filled with zeros are bounded by max_loss_tolerant_gap.
loss_tolerant.aead_note: AEAD authentication failures are never suppressed by allow_lossy or LOSS_TOLERANT flag.

aead.note: AEAD decryption failures are never suppressed. Plaintext is not released until authentication succeeds. Working buffer is zeroized on failure before error return.

arbitrary_byte_erasure_repair.reason: spec gap — no normative byte-to-block mapping defined for arbitrary byte erasure positions
arbitrary_byte_erasure_repair.behavior: plan_archive_repair returns RecoveryUnavailable for non-block-aligned erasures

cdc.external_provider_handling: CDC_EXT_PROVIDER is parsed as inert metadata only; no network/provider access is performed in M9a.
cdc.recipe_hash_verification: Unavailable as a portable claim while recipe hash algorithm/profile is not fully specified.
cdc.boundary_regeneration_verification: Unavailable as a portable claim until FastCDC parameters and CDC transformation domain are normatively specified or encoded.
cdc.cdc_map_interpretation: CDC_MAP is treated as stored metadata for parsing/structural validation; it is not proof of portable cross-writer deterministic chunking.
cdc.metadata_authority: For M9a, stored CDC map/catalog metadata is authoritative for parsing and interpretation when self-consistent.

commands.description: Verify archive integrity. Accepts --recovery to validate fragmentation, sparse, and Data Recovery TLV metadata. Accepts --cdc for structural CDC validation only.

options.name: --password
options.description: Explicit archive password for encrypted archives.

options.name: --recovery
options.description: Additionally validates fragmentation, sparse, and Data Recovery TLV metadata.

options.name: --cdc
options.description: Additionally validates CDC metadata structurally from stored records; does not claim FASTCDC boundary-regeneration verification or external-provider recipe resolution.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text

commands.notes: Verification is structural and metadata-oriented. CDC verification does not regenerate boundaries, does not attempt recipe reconstruction or external-provider resolution, and reports recipe-hash verification as unavailable while algorithm/profile/domain spec gaps remain.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the crate version plus SAR spec and central-dictionary version markers.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text

commands.name: repair
commands.usage: sar repair <archive.sar> <output.sar> --fec [--erasures erasures.json] [--max-archive-size BYTES] [--max-decoded-entry-size BYTES] [--max-in-memory-buffer BYTES] [--max-total-pipeline-memory BYTES] [--max-sparse-map-bytes BYTES] [--max-sparse-descriptors COUNT] [--max-fragment-count COUNT] [--max-fragment-group-span BYTES] [--max-loss-tolerant-gap BYTES] [--max-recovery-protected-range BYTES] [--max-repair-working-set BYTES]
commands.description: Apply archive-level XOR/RS erasure repair. Pre-checks archive-size and repair-working-set limits before reading. Does not finalize output after resource-limit failure. Non-block-aligned erasures return RecoveryUnavailable (spec gap).

options.name: --fec
options.description: Required flag enabling FEC-based repair mode.

options.name: --erasures erasures.json
options.description: JSON file describing block-aligned erasure positions.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text including SAR_ERR_LIMIT_EXCEEDED for resource-limit violations

commands.notes: Pre-checks archive-size and repair-working-set limits. Does not finalize output after limit failures. Non-block-aligned erasures return RecoveryUnavailable (spec gap; see SPEC_QUESTIONS.md).

cdc_algorithm_registry.name: FASTCDC
cdc_algorithm_registry.verification_behavior: accepted; boundary regeneration portability not claimed

blocked_by_spec_gap: Portable recipe-hash verification when hash algorithm/profile/domain are unspecified

error_behavior.condition: malformed CDC metadata bytes or UTF-8 provider TLV
